admission.justification: New fields and fixed placement alone still allow competing prose authorities; refusals alone would erase or strand old documents without grandfathering, retained reading and optional-field compatibility, so only the members together provide one forward authoring home without destroying historical access.

guarantee: Optional nonGoals and acceptance have typed homes at fixed master/task positions. One reserved-home policy refuses new restated headings and header labels while keeping existing sections/notes editable and removable; old documents load, render and accept ordinary edits without supplying the new optional fields. Dependencies inform display, not start or readiness authority. Existing Further-notes deduplication and complete-content navigation retain their separate owners.
title: Canonical recurring prose with historical compatibility
